rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent for an inevitable or necessary result.

example.english: If you do it this way, you will necessarily succeed.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 zou6 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1

rows.note: Use this in negative contexts corresponding to English “not necessarily,” especially before a predicate.

example.english: Eating a light diet does not necessarily mean your health will recover.
example.traditional: 食得清淡，身體唔一定就會好返。
example.jyutping: sik6 dak1 cing1 daam6 san1 tai2 m4 jat1 ding6 zau6 wui5 hou2 faan1

rows.note: Choose this for a more formal or explicit statement that something follows inevitably as a necessary result.

example.english: After the market opens, competition will necessarily intensify.
example.traditional: 市場開放之後，競爭必然會加劇。
example.jyutping: si5 coeng4 hoi1 fong3 zi1 hau6 ging6 zang1 bit1 jin4 wui5 gaa1 kek6
